principle: Deal Sniffer is NOT the bank. Payment authorization, capture, refunds, payouts, KYC/identity obligations (where applicable) and related compliance belong to a marketplace payment provider. This file is the BOUNDARY our code will call across; the provider is replaceable and is not chosen (UNKNOWN; a Michael + legal decision). Nothing here is built, enabled or granted.

provider.note: UNKNOWN. A provider must be able to: hold funds outside Deal Sniffer, perform KYC/identity checks it is obliged to, support idempotency keys, return a durable event id for every call, and support lookup by idempotency key (the reconciliation rule: ask the provider, never resend).

operations.note: Hold funds against a bid/booking. Undone by release_authorization.
Take the money. Refund is a separate, partially reversible act.

controls.live_spend: pinned 0 by the policy schema in wave one; lifting it needs a separate explicit Michael decision, a schema change and a migration
every_call_requires: step-up YES on the exact payload hash
controls.never_retry_blind: an irreversible operation that times out is reconciled by provider lookup, then settled failed or executed; never resent (E-05/R22)
controls.bounded_by: mbos.budget_ledger caps (per action, daily, global, cash-at-risk); a money.payment.* call counts against the money bucket
